citations.assessment: The exact headword supports the indicated pointer, while the name equivalence remains Heilprin’s inference.
Heilprin’s Rami article gives a specific Ammi form in discussing another patronym. It does not establish a universal reading.
In the specific example supplied by Heilprin’s Rami article, the Yerushalmi reads Immi and the Bavli has Rami with the same patronym.

evidence.witness: The Jerusalem Talmud, edition by Heinrich W. Guggenheimer. Berlin, De Gruyter, 1999-2015
